versions.changelog:
- Added reference documentation on book extraction methodology at references/book-extraction-methodology.md
- Introduced metadata to SKILL.md, clarifying platform compatibility, homepage, and emoji icon

Initial release – advanced knowledge extraction from lengthy methodology/business/psychology/self-help books using Four-Layer Methodology.

- Systematically distills books into frameworks, case studies, implementation SOPs, and critical limitations.
- Offers Quick and Deep processing modes.
- Includes Feynman validation: scenario simulation, exercises, self-assessment, and teaching-back.
- Multi-format export: Markdown, PDF, and Word reports.
- Optimized for extracting actionable, transferable insights and building structured knowledge bases.
